item.title: What are the main events for today?
item.description: EUROPEAN SESSIONIn the European session, the main highlight was the UK Q4 GDP report. The data was slightly weaker than expected but didn't change materially the current BoE outlook, so the market reaction was limited. We don't have much on the agenda for the rest of the session, so the price action will likely be rangebound as we await the US CPI report coming up tomorrow.
